issue: readCaps derives maxFrontierNodes from the configured maxIterations (lines 262-264) while seedBudget derives it from the seed-sized budget (line 323). The comment at line 259 states the two agree; they do not. With the shipped research config (maxIterations 10) and the documented six-seed decomposition, seedNodes reports growthSlots 2 and no warning, but readCaps enforces a cap of 5, so the first child proposal is pruned as 'fanout' and the frontier can never grow past the seed. The review default (maxIterations 7) is worse: the seed reports growthSlots 4 while readCaps enforces 3. The 'no growth slot' warning therefore never fires when it should, and the stderr budget line the orchestrator reads is wrong. The two unit tests encode the two disagreeing formulas (frontier-admit.vitest.ts:740 asserts growthSlots 2 for maxIterations 10; frontier-admit.vitest.ts:666 asserts maxFrontierNodes 3 for maxIterations 7), so neither can fail on the divergence.
